caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object resembling the head of a staff or the scroll of a musical instrument, such as a violin or a decorative architectural element. The object is rendered in shades of dark brown, black, and muted reddish-brown, with some lighter highlights that suggest a metallic or polished wooden surface. The top portion of the object consists of a spiral, resembling a coiled fern or volute, with layered, petal-like segments in the center. Along the outer curve of the spiral, there are a series of evenly spaced, rectangular perforations or cut-outs. emanating from the lower part of the spiral, two leaf-like forms extend downward, each with prominent central veins and rounded lobes; one of these leaves has two spherical berry-like shapes attached to it. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small, handwritten signature and date ("Clarence Secor '38") at the lower edge of the paper.
title: Perforated Scroll
